name: Yamiyuku Kimi ni Hanataba o ～Bouquet for you in the dark～
original_name: 闇ゆく君に花束を～Bouquet for you in the dark～
source:
The heroine is given the job of handling the student council's social media, and she begins work along with three other students:

- The underclassman who's famous for having flashy relationships

- The flawless boy in the same grade

- The upperclassman who's hard to get close to

As she interacts with them, she begins to see glimpses of the darkness within them...

Will she fall into darkness with them?  Or will she take their hand?

(Translated from the official website: https://karakuren.wixsite.com/yamikimi )
translation:
女主角负责处理学生会的社交媒体，她和其他三名学生一起开始工作：

- 因关系浮夸而闻名的低年级学生

- 同年级最完美的男生

- 难以接近的学长

当她与他们互动时，她开始看到他们内心的黑暗……

她会和他们一起坠入黑暗吗？或者她会握住他们的手吗？

（翻译自官网：https://karakuren.wixsite.com/yamikimi）
